hypothesis: The current GVS-v1 lineage and schema-allocation contract can be populated honestly at the proposed effective D-support, S-new, and C-new sizes without laundering row identifiers into independence claims.
decision_enabled: Close GVS-v1 before collection or model access if its requested effective sample sizes are mathematically incompatible with honest lineage semantics; preserve the untested model mechanism as an open idea for a genuinely versioned future contract.

forced_graph_properties.edge_rule: Records are unioned when they share any author, source, collection batch, schema family, program template, paraphrase family, temporal construction, entity pool, source commitment, or duplicate lineage.
forced_graph_properties.analysis_unit: The power builder uses the resulting eligible connected components, never nominal rows.
forced_graph_properties.cross_role_rule: Any component spanning T-new, D-support, S-new, or C-new is rejected.
forced_graph_properties.within_component_rule: Members must agree on task class, expected outcome, action family, eligibility, and the complete pre-outcome strata vector.
forced_graph_properties.singleton_requirement: Reaching N effective components from N rows requires every eligible row to remain distinct on every union-producing lineage axis.

incompatibilities.evidence: The current schema partition permits eight renamed families per role, so direct use as provenance.schema_family caps a same-classification role at eight components before other axes are considered.

One honest shared collection batch, source root, template, entity catalogue, or generator ancestry transitively joins otherwise distinct schema families. Per-row aliases for a shared root would be false provenance.

The same canonical identity presentation used in two roles is the same schema family and creates a forbidden cross-role component. Role-specific IDs for identical presentation ancestry would be identifier laundering.

The current population record requires nonempty entity and temporal lineage identifiers. One truthful shared not-applicable identifier collapses all such rows, while unique not-applicable identifiers fabricate independence.

Thirty-two thousand unique alias-map byte strings generated by one macro share the macro, lexicon policy, canonical schema, and generation assumptions. Distinct bytes alone do not create 32,000 independent schema sources.
The deterministic T/D planner explicitly labels its unique program, authoring, entity, and temporal slots as allocation slots rather than post-authoring provenance.

human_collection_implications.consequence: Any duplicate, provenance failure, invalid schema, or quality exclusion makes the exact nominal target unattainable, and annotator-correlated error remains unmodeled.

minimum_future_contract_changes: Define every lineage field normatively and derive hierarchical ancestry from signed source receipts.
Add nullable non-edge states for genuinely inapplicable entity or temporal axes.
Bind exact schema presentations and their generator, lexicon, and template ancestors before authoring using role-blind whole-family assignment.
Separate the strict cross-role contamination graph from a preregistered inferential design with genuine source/author units and multiway or hierarchical clustering of nuisance factors.
Treat the canonical identity schema as a shared fixed compatibility lane with no unseen-schema claim.
Add labeler, reviewer, and adjudicator ancestry to dependence accounting.
Allow outcome-blind reserve collection and freeze power only after pre-outcome quality and duplicate closure.
reason: Under the current contract, the requested effective sample sizes require singleton status on every lineage axis, but the proposed populations necessarily share real schema, generator, batch, template, entity, temporal, and annotator ancestry. Reaching the requested counts would require false per-row identities.
scope_of_rejection: GVS-v1 population and inferential contract. No verifier, generator-support, or model-quality conclusion exists because no model was accessed.
next: Do not patch identifiers or launch GVS-v1. Either preregister a genuinely versioned population/inference contract with the listed structural changes, or pivot to a distinct generator-side correction experiment on a new leakage-controlled internal development boundary while retaining candidate-v2 as the public release.
